# meshed

> Link functions up into callable objects


## Pages in this subsection

- [meshed](meshed.html.md): &#96;meshed&#96; contains a set of tools that allow the developer to provide a collection

- [meshed.examples.vaccine_vs_no_vaccine](meshed.examples.vaccine_vs_no_vaccine.html.md): Simple model relating vaccination to death toll, involving exposure and infection rate.
